summary: The test suite covers core functionality well (glob matching, label assignment, config parsing, workflow execution). Unit tests systematically build up from glob matching through label assignment to rendering. The workflow tests comprehensively validate structure and end-to-end execution through `act` with exact output assertions. However, edge case coverage is sparse: glob patterns lack tests for empty inputs, multiple consecutive `**`, and special regex characters; config parsing tests only a few error types; CLI argument parsing and file I/O error scenarios lack dedicated tests; only three fixture cases exercise the workflow. The test suite would catch most regressions in happy paths and main requirements but could miss edge cases and some error-handling paths.
